DataContract/_template/contract/my_datas:
# =============================================================================
# Data Contract Template (ODCS v3.0.2)
# =============================================================================
# วิธีใช้:
#   1. copy ไฟล์นี้ไปที่ DataContract/<source>/contract/<dataset>.odcs.yaml
#   2. copy ไฟล์ pipeline คู่กันไปที่ DataContract/<source>/pipeline/<dataset>.pipeline.yaml
#   3. แก้ค่าทุกตัวที่ขึ้นต้นด้วย my_ / example
#   4. รัน:  uv run mdf validate
#
# ไฟล์นี้เก็บเฉพาะ "สิ่งที่ต้นทางรับปาก" (schema, ประเภทข้อมูล PDPA/PCI, SLA, ที่วางไฟล์)
# ห้ามใส่: derived column, dedup, business rule, retention -> ไปใส่ในไฟล์ pipeline
# DQ library: config/dq_library.yaml; structural rules: config/rules/*.rules.json
# =============================================================================

apiVersion: v3.0.2 # ห้ามเปลี่ยน
kind: DataContract # ห้ามเปลี่ยน
id: my_source.my_dataset # <source>.<dataset> ต้องตรงกับชื่อโฟลเดอร์/ชื่อไฟล์
name: my_dataset # ตัวพิมพ์เล็ก snake_case
version: 1.0.0 # semver: เปลี่ยน schema แบบ breaking -> ขึ้นเลขหน้า (2.0.0)
status: draft # draft | active | deprecated
domain: my_domain # เช่น customer, card, sales
description:
  purpose: "อธิบายภาพรวมและวัตถุประสงค์ทางธุรกิจของข้อมูลชุดนี้" # ขั้นต่ำ 20 ตัวอักษร

team:
  - username: someone@example.com # อีเมลผู้ดูแลข้อมูล (Data Steward)
    role: steward
  - username: source-system-owner # ทีมหรือระบบต้นทาง
    role: owner

# ที่วางไฟล์ (landing) — 1 รายการต่อ 1 env ที่มีใน config/env/*.yaml
servers:
  - server: landing-dev
    environment: dev
    type: custom
    format: csv # csv | json | jsonl | parquet
    location: "/Volumes/{catalog}/landing_{source}/files/my_dataset/"

# CALENDAR AUTHORING — STAGED, not parsed by the current generator.
# Owner values are unconfigured; do not infer schedule/timezone from frequency/env.
# One ODCS-compatible customProperties entry is proposed below (comments only).
# Keep executable SLA fields below until coordinated SWE migration (FR-N.1–N.6).
# Never uncomment beside legacy calendar fields: one source only after cutover.
# See reports/calendar-simplification/analysis.md and proposed/ for staged YAML.
# customProperties calendar entry (proposed, not production defaults):
# property: calendar
# value:
#   frequency: daily
#   schedule_type: null
#   timezone: null
#   expected_at: null
#   expected_day_offset: null
#   effective_from: null
#   latency:
#     value: 4
#     unit: h
#   recovery_window: null

slaProperties:
  - property: frequency
    value: daily # daily | hourly | weekly | monthly
  - property: latency # grace period ก่อนถือว่าไฟล์หาย
    value: 4
    unit: h # h | d (current calendar parser)
  # Current legacy parser: expected_at/offset/timezone/schedule remain absent until owner supplies them.

customProperties:
  - property: source_system
    value: my_source
  - property: source_type
    value: batch_file # batch_file | derived
  - property: file_pattern
    value: "my_dataset_{{business_date}}.csv"
  - property: partition_pattern
    value: "business_date={{business_date}}"
  - property: header
    value: true
  - property: encoding
    value: utf-8
  - property: run_grain
    value: business_date
  - property: erasure_target
    value: vault # vault | silver | bronze | null (ต้องคุยกับ DPO)

schema:
  - name: my_dataset # ต้องตรงกับ name ด้านบน
    physicalType: table
    properties:
      # คีย์ที่ต้องมีทุกคอลัมน์: name, logicalType, physicalType, required,
      #                        classification, description, customProperties(pii, pci)
      - name: my_id
        logicalType: string # string | integer | number | date | boolean
        physicalType: string # string | integer | long | double | boolean | date | timestamp | decimal(p,s)
        required: true # true = ห้ามเป็น null
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 1
        classification: none # none | personal | sensitive (PDPA)
        description: "รหัสอ้างอิงหลักประจำแถวข้อมูล (Primary Key)"
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: national_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: sensitive
        logicalTypeOptions:
          pattern: "^[0-9]{13}$" # regex ที่ต้นทางรับปาก
        tags: ["dq:pattern"]
        description: "เลขประจำตัวประชาชน 13 หลัก ถูกแปลงเป็น token ตอนเขียน silver"
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: true }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: birth_date
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: date
        required: true
        classification: sensitive
        description: "วันเดือนปีเกิดของลูกค้า สำหรับการวิเคราะห์และคำนวณอายุ"
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: true }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: status
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: none
        tags: ["dq:valid_values"]
        description: "สถานะของรายการ (ตัวอย่าง allowed values)"
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
          - { property: valid_values, value: ["ACTIVE", "CLOSED"] }

      - name: business_date
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: date
        required: true
        partitioned: true
        partitionKeyPosition: 1
        classification: none
        description: "วันที่ของข้อมูลธุรกิจ ใช้สำหรับแบ่ง partition"
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
DataContract/cc/contract/customer.odcs.y:
# Data contract - customer (dataset 1/3)
#
# IMPORTANT: this contract is deliberately written to be PARTLY WRONG about
# the real data. That is the point of testing - we do not trust the
# source's data dictionary, so the contract-vs-reality gate must be able to
# catch a source that claims something untrue. The claims marked
# `# REALITY:` below are the planted lies.
#
# Nothing here should be "fixed" to match the data. Fixing it would delete
# the test. Every `# REALITY:` line below is byte-for-byte unchanged.
#
# Format: ODCS v3.0.2 (converted from DataContract/_legacy/cc/customer.yaml).
# Pipeline behaviour (business rules, dedup, tokenise, retention) lives in
# DataContract/cc/pipeline/customer.pipeline.yaml

apiVersion: v3.0.2
kind: DataContract
id: cc.customer
name: customer
version: 1.0.0
status: active
domain: customer
description:
  purpose: "Customer master with PII. One file per business_date."

team:
  - username: <steward>
    role: steward
  - username: source-system-owner
    role: owner

servers:
  - server: landing-dev
    environment: dev
    type: custom
    format: csv
    location: "/Volumes/{catalog}/landing_{source}/files/customer/"

# CALENDAR AUTHORING — STAGED, not parsed by the current generator.
# Owner values are unconfigured; do not infer schedule/timezone from frequency/env.
# One ODCS-compatible customProperties entry is proposed below (comments only).
# Keep executable SLA fields below until coordinated SWE migration (FR-N.1–N.6).
# Never uncomment beside legacy calendar fields: one source only after cutover.
# See reports/calendar-simplification/analysis.md and proposed/ for staged YAML.
# customProperties calendar entry (proposed, not production defaults):
# property: calendar
# value:
#   frequency: daily
#   schedule_type: null
#   timezone: null
#   expected_at: null
#   expected_day_offset: null
#   effective_from: null
#   latency:
#     value: 4
#     unit: h
#   recovery_window:
#     value: 2
#     unit: d

slaProperties:
  - property: frequency
    value: daily
  - property: latency # grace period before a file counts as missing
    value: 4
    unit: h
  - property: recovery_window # AS-31: 2 d retry window before escalation (CR-01)
    value: 2
    unit: d

customProperties:
  - property: source_system
    value: cc
  - property: source_type
    value: batch_file
  - property: file_pattern
    value: "customer_{{business_date}}.csv"
  - property: partition_pattern
    value: ""
  - property: header
    value: true
  - property: encoding
    value: utf-8
  - property: run_grain
    value: business_date
  - property: erasure_target
    value: vault

schema:
  - name: customer
    physicalType: table
    properties:
      - name: customer_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 1
        classification: none
        description: "Stable customer identifier"
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: national_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: sensitive
        logicalTypeOptions:
          pattern:
            "^[0-9]{13}$" # REALITY: one row per file is "123". The gate
            # must FAIL this claim, not silently pass.
        tags: ["dq:pattern"]
        description: "Thai national ID. Source claims always 13 digits."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: true }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: full_name
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: sensitive
        description: "REALITY: one row per file is empty despite nullable=false"
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: true }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: birth_date
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: date
        required: true
        classification: sensitive
        description: "REALITY: one row per file is in the future"
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: true }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: email
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: false
        classification: personal
        description: "Customer primary contact email address."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: true }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: phone
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: false
        classification: personal
        description: "Customer contact mobile phone number."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: true }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: registered_date
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: date
        required: false
        classification: none
        description: "Date when customer account was registered."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: customer_status
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: none
        tags: ["dq:valid_values"]
        description: "Lifecycle status of customer account."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
          - { property: valid_values, value: ["ACTIVE", "DORMANT", "CLOSED"] }

      - name: business_date
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: date
        required: true
        partitioned: true
        partitionKeyPosition: 1
        classification: none
        description: "Partition key. FR-D.5: one run handles exactly one."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
DataContract/cc/contract/credit_card.odc:
# Data contract - credit_card (dataset 2/3)
#
# card_pan is BOTH PCI data AND the business key used for join/upsert/partition.
# As with customer_v1.yaml, some claims here are deliberately wrong. See
# `# REALITY:` markers. All REALITY lines below are byte-for-byte unchanged.
#
# Format: ODCS v3.0.2 (converted from DataContract/_legacy/cc/credit_card.yaml).
# Pipeline behaviour lives in DataContract/cc/pipeline/credit_card.pipeline.yaml

apiVersion: v3.0.2
kind: DataContract
id: cc.credit_card
name: credit_card
version: 1.0.0
status: active
domain: card
description:
  purpose: "Card master. PCI. card_pan is the business key."

team:
  - username: <steward>
    role: steward
  - username: source-system-owner
    role: owner

servers:
  - server: landing-dev
    environment: dev
    type: custom
    format: csv
    location: "/Volumes/{catalog}/landing_{source}/files/credit_card/"

# CALENDAR AUTHORING — STAGED, not parsed by the current generator.
# Owner values are unconfigured; do not infer schedule/timezone from frequency/env.
# One ODCS-compatible customProperties entry is proposed below (comments only).
# Keep executable SLA fields below until coordinated SWE migration (FR-N.1–N.6).
# Never uncomment beside legacy calendar fields: one source only after cutover.
# See reports/calendar-simplification/analysis.md and proposed/ for staged YAML.
# customProperties calendar entry (proposed, not production defaults):
# property: calendar
# value:
#   frequency: daily
#   schedule_type: null
#   timezone: null
#   expected_at: null
#   expected_day_offset: null
#   effective_from: null
#   latency:
#     value: 4
#     unit: h
#   recovery_window:
#     value: 2
#     unit: d

slaProperties:
  - property: frequency
    value: daily
  - property: latency # grace period before a file counts as missing
    value: 4
    unit: h
  - property: recovery_window # AS-31: 2 d retry window before escalation (CR-01)
    value: 2
    unit: d
  # REALITY: the file for business_date=2026-09-10 is never delivered.
  # Reconciliation must raise MISSING after the grace period (prawden 1),
  # and must NOT silently treat the gap as "no cards issued that day".

customProperties:
  - property: source_system
    value: cc
  - property: source_type
    value: batch_file
  - property: file_pattern
    value: "credit_card_{{business_date}}.csv"
  - property: partition_pattern
    value: ""
  - property: header
    value: true
  - property: encoding
    value: utf-8
  - property: run_grain
    value: business_date
  - property: erasure_target
    value: vault

schema:
  - name: credit_card
    physicalType: table
    properties:
      - name: card_pan
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 1
        classification: sensitive
        logicalTypeOptions:
          pattern:
            "^[0-9]{15,16}$" # REALITY: fails on the spaced variant
            # BEFORE normalisation - which is the
            # behaviour we want to observe
        tags: ["dq:pattern", "dq:luhn"]
        description: "Card PAN. Test BINs only in this environment."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: true }
          - { property: pci, value: true }
        # REALITY: the same PAN is re-sent with spaces ("5555 5500 ...").
        # Without this normalisation step the two forms tokenise to two
        # different tokens and one card silently becomes two.
        # (normalise: strip_whitespace -> DataContract/cc/pipeline/credit_card.pipeline.yaml)

      - name: customer_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: none
        tags: ["dq:fk"]
        description: "REALITY: one row per file references CUST999999, which
          does not exist. Silver join must not silently drop it
          (prawden 8)."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
          - { property: foreign_key, value: cc.customer.customer_id }

      - name: card_type
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: none
        tags: ["dq:valid_values"]
        description: "Card brand scheme (VISA, MASTERCARD, AMEX)."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
          - { property: valid_values, value: ["VISA", "MASTERCARD", "AMEX"] }

      - name: issue_date
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: date
        required: true
        classification: none
        description: "Date when the credit card was issued."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: expiry_date
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: date
        required: true
        classification: none
        description: "Expiration date of the credit card."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: credit_limit
        logicalType: number
        physicalType: decimal(18,2)
        required: true
        classification: none
        description: "REALITY: one row per file contains the text 'UNLIMITED'
          in this numeric column."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: card_status
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: none
        tags: ["dq:valid_values"]
        description: "Operational status of credit card account."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
          - { property: valid_values, value: ["ACTIVE", "BLOCKED", "EXPIRED"] }

      - name: business_date
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: date
        required: true
        partitioned: true
        partitionKeyPosition: 1
        classification: none
        description: "Business date partition key."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
DataContract/cc/contract/credit_card_txn:
# Data contract - credit_card_txn (dataset 3/3)
#
# The high-volume fact table. One run = exactly one business_date.
# All REALITY notes here are carried over unchanged.
#
# Format: ODCS v3.0.2 (converted from DataContract/_legacy/cc/credit_card_txn.yaml).
# Pipeline behaviour lives in DataContract/cc/pipeline/credit_card_txn.pipeline.yaml

apiVersion: v3.0.2
kind: DataContract
id: cc.credit_card_txn
name: credit_card_txn
version: 1.0.0
status: active
domain: card
description:
  purpose: "Card transactions. High volume fact, one file per business_date."

team:
  - username: <steward>
    role: steward
  - username: source-system-owner
    role: owner

servers:
  - server: landing-dev
    environment: dev
    type: custom
    format: csv
    location: "/Volumes/{catalog}/landing_{source}/files/credit_card_txn/"

# CALENDAR AUTHORING — STAGED, not parsed by the current generator.
# Owner values are unconfigured; do not infer schedule/timezone from frequency/env.
# One ODCS-compatible customProperties entry is proposed below (comments only).
# Keep executable SLA fields below until coordinated SWE migration (FR-N.1–N.6).
# Never uncomment beside legacy calendar fields: one source only after cutover.
# See reports/calendar-simplification/analysis.md and proposed/ for staged YAML.
# customProperties calendar entry (proposed, not production defaults):
# property: calendar
# value:
#   frequency: daily
#   schedule_type: null
#   timezone: null
#   expected_at: null
#   expected_day_offset: null
#   effective_from: null
#   latency:
#     value: 4
#     unit: h
#   recovery_window:
#     value: 2
#     unit: d

slaProperties:
  - property: frequency
    value: daily
  - property: latency # grace period before a file counts as missing
    value: 4
    unit: h
  - property: recovery_window # AS-31: 2 d retry window before escalation (CR-01)
    value: 2
    unit: d
  # REALITY: business_date=2026-09-11 arrives LATE (outside the normal
  # window, inside grace). Per FR-E.6 this must NOT page anyone - a late
  # file within grace is not an incident. It must still be recorded as LATE
  # so the arrival-pattern history is honest (prawden 1, prawden 5).

customProperties:
  - property: source_system
    value: cc
  - property: source_type
    value: batch_file
  - property: file_pattern
    value: "credit_card_txn_{{business_date}}*.csv"
    # note the glob: the late file is named ..._2026-09-11.late.csv
  - property: partition_pattern
    value: ""
  - property: header
    value: true
  - property: encoding
    value: utf-8
  - property: run_grain
    value: business_date
  - property: erasure_target
    value: null

schema:
  - name: credit_card_txn
    physicalType: table
    properties:
      - name: txn_id
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        primaryKey: true
        primaryKeyPosition: 1
        classification: none
        description: "Unique transaction identifier primary key."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: card_pan
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: sensitive
        tags: ["dq:fk"]
        description: "REALITY: one row per file uses a PAN that appears in no
          credit_card file (prawden 8). Also: every txn on
          business_date=2026-09-10 references cards whose master
          file was never delivered - the join must degrade
          gracefully rather than dropping a day of revenue."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: true }
          - { property: pci, value: true }
          - { property: foreign_key, value: cc.credit_card.card_pan }

      - name: txn_timestamp
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: timestamp
        required: true
        classification: none
        description: "REALITY: one row per file is empty."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: amount
        logicalType: number
        physicalType: decimal(18,2)
        required: true
        classification: none
        description: "REALITY: one APPROVED row per file has a negative amount."
        customProperties:

          - { property: pci, value: false }

        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: none
        tags: ["dq:valid_values"]
        description: "ISO currency code for transaction amount."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
          - { property: valid_values, value: ["THB"] }

        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: false

          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: merchant_category
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: false
        classification: none
        description: "Merchant classification and category code."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }

      - name: txn_status
        logicalType: string
        physicalType: string
        required: true
        classification: none
        tags: ["dq:valid_values"]
        description: "Transaction processing result status."

          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
          - { property: valid_values, value: ["APPROVED", "DECLINED", "REVERSED"] }

      - name: business_date
        logicalType: date
        physicalType: date
        required: true
        partitioned: true
        partitionKeyPosition: 1
        classification: none
        description: "Business date partition key."
        customProperties:
          - { property: pii, value: false }
          - { property: pci, value: false }
